    Coordinate subspaces and Schur poset spaces #

    This file isolates the linear-algebraic endpoint of the manuscript's common-adapted-basis argument. Once all distinguished subspaces of a poset space are coordinate subspaces for one basis, a coordinate projection is a poset-space endomorphism. The Schur condition then forces total dimension at most one.
